messages:
Alex K: Quick handover — I'm taking the oncall until 18:00 PT. Heads up: planned deploy for models-service at 16:00 PT (staggered canary across region-a -> region-b). No DB migrations. Expected risk: the autoscaler tweak from this morning might cause a brief CPU/scale spike on inference workers during the first few minutes. Freeze window: 15:30–17:00 PT (no infra/scale policy changes during). Looking for one rollback watcher and one rollout observer. I'll kick off canary and monitor metrics.

Priya R: +1 on watcher. Can you confirm whether KV cache invalidation will run? last time that caused extra latency.

Alex K: Good call — we're NOT invalidating KV cache this rollout. Change is an env var (ENABLE_NEW_BATCHER=true) + config to route 10% traffic to canary. No cache flush.

Jamal T: I can be rollback watcher. Which traffic buckets are targeted?

Alex K: Canary targets traffic tag `beta-users` and 10% of `all` via router rule. If latency p50 rises >200ms or error rate >=0.5% for 3 consecutive mins, rollback plan A = disable canary routing, plan B = revert to previous image.

Sarah M: I'll run the smoke checks and basic traces during rollout. Sharing the smoke test command I'll use:
```
# basic health + latency check
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" https://models-service.internal/health || echo "health failed"
```
I'll run that before canary, then at 1m / 5m after.

Oncall Bot: Reminder — Scheduled deploy for `models-service` at 2026-08-12T16:00:00-07:00. Auto-notifications to rollout-watchers enabled.

Li W: FYI I bumped the node autoscaler threshold from 65%->75% at 09:12 this morning (was trying to avoid flapping). That might delay scale up for the canary burst. Keep an eye on pod CPU throttling and pending pods. If we see pending pods > 2 for >2min, manually scale the nodegroup.

Priya R: Thanks for the autoscaler note. If we need faster scale we can temporarily set min nodes +2 for the nodegroup; prefer doing that early so it stabilizes before canary.

Alex K: Good plan. I'll set min nodes +2 at 15:45 if metrics look okay. Quick rollout checklist for watchers:
- Monitor latency p50/p95 (Grafana: infra/latency/models-service)
- Error count and 5xx rate (alerts already configured)
- Pod pending/OOM/RSS on node (k8s dashboard)
- Trace sampling for requests hitting canary (tag=canary)
- Smoke tests (Sarah)
- If rollback required: disable routing, notify infra, create revert PR for image pin.

Sarah M: I'll post results in this thread after the 1m and 5m checks.

Jamal T: Will watch for rollback triggers, ping me with `@Jamal T` if you flip routing.

Alex K: Thanks all — leaving notes in runbook (linked) and will hand over to Priya for the 17:00–end shift. Filing this as non-incident FYI. :thumbsup:
